ops.title: cc-sync Orca cross-machine recovery interface contract v1
ops.body:
# cc-sync ↔ Orca cross-machine recovery interface contract (v1)

Source: coordinator synthesis of mapping lanes orca-host-runtime + orca-client-ui + consumer-reference (Run wf_60d8895a-f7f), under approved doc 7c9a89b. Orca base: stablyai/orca main a85057ef48 (installed 1.4.212; gate purely by capability, no protocol version bump).

## Naming
Plain "recovery" already means other things in Orca (TerminalTab.recovery, profile-state recovery, browser page recovery). Code, RPC, IPC and capability names use the `crossMachineRecovery` / `cross-machine-recovery` prefix. The user-facing CLI group is `orca recovery` unless that group name already exists, in which case `orca cross-machine-recovery`.

Frame the Orca side as a generic external recovery provider (settings `crossMachineRecovery.providerPath`, default `cc-sync` resolved from the main-process PATH) so an upstream PR stays viable.

## Capabilities (appended to RUNTIME_CAPABILITIES in src/shared/protocol-version.ts; RUNTIME_PROTOCOL_VERSION unchanged)
- `cross-machine-recovery.workspace.v1`: crossMachineRecovery.describe/export/import/resume/list
- `cross-machine-recovery.presentation.v1`: crossMachineRecovery.presentation.publish
cc-sync gates on them via `orca status --json` → result.runtime.capabilities. When only workspace.v1 is present, export reports presentation.freshness = 'host-only'.

## Local routing (both sides enforce)
- cc-sync execs `orca` with ORCA_ENVIRONMENT, ORCA_PAIRING_CODE, ORCA_REMOTE_PAIRING removed from env and never passes --environment/--pairing-code/--host.
- Orca CLI adds the recovery group to shouldIgnoreRemoteSelection (src/cli/index.ts), so remote selection inputs are ignored even when present.
- cc-sync verifies before any import/export: (a) `orca status --json` → result.target.kind=='local', runtime reachable, capability present; (b) `orca recovery describe --json` → result.executionHostId=='local' and result.runtimeId == status runtimeId.
- The host refuses every crossMachineRecovery.* call except presentation.publish when the RPC context has clientKind 'mobile'|'runtime' or a pairedDeviceId → error code `recovery_local_only`.
- The native picker never uses getActiveRuntimeTarget / window.api.runtime.call (web maps runtime.call to the remote env). It uses desktop-only Electron IPC to local main; the web build gets an explicit stub with isSupported:false. The picker header always reads "Recovers to this computer (<machine name>)" even while the window displays a runtime:<id> host.

## Descriptor (src/shared/cross-machine-recovery-descriptor.ts + strict zod in src/shared/rpc-contract/cross-machine-recovery-params.ts)
MAX_RECOVERY_DESCRIPTOR_BYTES = 4 MiB (serialize with stringifyJsonWithinByteLimit; over cap → `recovery_descriptor_too_large`; trimming drops browser page lists first).

```ts
type OrcaRecoveryDescriptorV1 = {
  version: 1; exportedAt: number
  source: { runtimeId: string; appVersion: string; machineName: string; platform: NodeJS.Platform; executionHostId: 'local' }
  repo: { id: string; path: string; displayName: string; kind?: RepoKind; upstream?: GitHubRepositoryIdentity | null; worktreeBaseRef?: string }
  workspace: { worktreeId: string; instanceId: string; path: string; branch: string | null;
               meta: Pick<WorktreeMeta,'displayName'|'comment'|'linkedIssue'|'linkedPR'|'linkedLinearIssue'|'linkedWorkItem'|'baseRef'|'createdWithAgent'|'lastActivityAt'|'isPinned'> }
  layout: RecoveryLayout                 // host-authoritative 'local' partition projection
  presentation: RecoveryPresentationExport
  bindings: RecoveryAgentBinding[]       // live + dormant + structured, deduped by providerSession.id, live wins
}
type RecoveryLayout = {
  tabs: Omit<Tab,'worktreeId'|'executionHostId'>[]; groups: Omit<TabGroup,'worktreeId'>[]; groupLayout: TabGroupLayoutNode | null  // ratios included
  activeGroupId: string | null
  terminalTabs: Omit<TerminalTab,'worktreeId'|'ptyId'|'generation'|'pendingActivationSpawn'|'recovery'|'forceHostRuntime'|'shellOverride'>[]
  terminalLayouts: Record<string, { root: TerminalPaneLayoutNode | null; activeLeafId: string | null; expandedLeafId: string | null; chatLeafId?: string; titlesByLeafId?: Record<string,string> }>
  startupCwdRelative: Record<string, string>
  editors: { relativePath: string; language: string; isPreview?: boolean; readOnly?: boolean }[]; activeEditorRelativePath: string | null
  browsers: { id: string; label?: string; activePageId: string | null; pages: { id: string; url: string; title?: string }[] }[]; activeBrowserId: string | null
  activeTabType: WorkspaceVisibleTabType | null; activeTabId: string | null
}
type RecoveryAgentBinding = {
  sourcePaneKey: string; sourceTabId: string; sourceLeafId: string | null
  surface: 'terminal' | 'structured'; agent: ResumableTuiAgent
  providerSession: { key: 'session_id' | 'conversation_id'; id: string; transcriptPath?: string }
  structuredCursor?: { provider: 'claude'; sessionId: string; leafUuid: string | null }   // agent-session tabs only
  liveness: 'live' | 'sleeping' | 'exited'; state: AgentStatusState
  launch: { launchPreferences?: { model?: string; effort?: string; mode?: string }; sourceAgentArgs: string | null; sourceEnvKeys: string[]; accountHomeVariable?: 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR' | 'CODEX_HOME' }
  terminalTitle?: string; prompt?: string; lastAssistantMessage?: string
  capturedAt: number; updatedAt: number; lastHumanInputAt: number | null
}
```
Export excludes ptyIdsByLeafId, buffersByLeafId, scrollbackRefsByLeafId, localOnlyScrollbackByTabId, pendingActivationSpawn, recovery ledgers, generation, pty incarnations/topology fences, dirtyDraftContent, launchConfig.agentCommand and agentEnv values (env key names kept for provenance only). A compile-time exhaustive RECOVERY_SESSION_FIELD_POLICY: Record<keyof WorkspaceSessionState,'export'|'drop'|'global'> guards future fields.

## Presentation publication (client → host)
- Client publishes a FULL replace of its views for a host: `{ clientInstanceId, clientName, clientRevision, workspaces: [{ workspace: {kind:'worktree',worktreeId,instanceId?}|{kind:'folder',folderWorkspaceId}, view: RecoveryLayout-shaped client view (no scrollback/drafts/history), focus: {isActiveWorkspace, focusedTabId, focusedLeafId, focusedPaneKey, windowFocused}, input: {msSinceHumanInput, msSinceHumanFocus, msSinceHumanInputByPaneKey} }] }` → `{ok:true, acknowledgedRevision, hostReceivedAt} | {ok:false, reason:'stale-revision'|'too-large'|'unavailable', acknowledgedRevision?}`.
- Relative ages only; the host stamps hostReceivedAt and derives lastHumanInputAt/lastHumanFocusAt (clock-skew safe).
- Paired runtime hosts: RPC `crossMachineRecovery.presentation.publish`, key `device:<ctx.pairedDeviceId>` (rejected when pairedDeviceId absent, so the unix-socket CLI cannot impersonate; clientInstanceId is a matching label, never authority); not in the mobile allowlist; client calls only when the env advertises the presentation capability.
- Local host: desktop-only Electron IPC `crossMachineRecovery:publishPresentationLocal`, key `local-renderer`.
- SSH hosts: not published (export layout 'host-bindings-only').
- Client publisher: 2 s trailing debounce, 10 s max-wait for view/focus changes; input-only changes at most once per 60 s; leading edge on workspace focus change; one in-flight request per host, newer snapshot supersedes unsent; backoff 5 s→5 min on unavailable; stale-revision → acknowledgedRevision+1 resend. Human-input tracker: capture-phase isTrusted keydown/pointerdown/wheel + window focus/blur, per focused pane key.
- Host store: durable file <userData>/cross-machine-recovery-presentations.json (withFileTransactionLock + writeTempFileDurable + renameDurable, bounded read), latest-by-revision per clientKey, ≤16 clients, 7 d retention by hostReceivedAt, ≤64 KiB per workspace view, ≤512 KiB per publish.
- Export: `presentation: { views: [{clientKey, clientInstanceId, clientName, clientKind, hostReceivedAt, lastHumanInputAt, lastHumanFocusAt, focus, view}], preferredClientKey: string | null, freshness: 'client-view' | 'host-only' }`; preferredClientKey = max lastHumanInputAt, else max lastHumanFocusAt, else newest hostReceivedAt.
- Import view selection: the view whose clientInstanceId == the importing desktop's own clientInstanceId (receiving client's saved view), else preferredClientKey (most recently human-used), else host layout. Host bindings always win over view structure; a view tab without a binding is a plain tab.
- Stable clientInstanceId: minted once by desktop main, stored in main persisted state; web mints in localStorage.

## Host RPC methods (src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/cross-machine-recovery.ts; logic under src/main/runtime/cross-machine-recovery/)
- `crossMachineRecovery.describe` → `{protocol:1, runtimeId, executionHostId:'local', appVersion, platform, machineName, hostKind:'desktop'|'headless', localClientInstanceId: string|null, capabilities}`
- `crossMachineRecovery.export` {worktree: WorktreeSelector 'id:…'|'path:…'} → {descriptor}
- `crossMachineRecovery.import` RecoveryImportRequest → RecoveryImportResult:
  - request `{descriptor, checkoutPath (must exist; restored by reposync), checkpointId, pathMap?: {from,to}[], resume?: string[] (providerSession ids), preferClientInstanceId?, activate?, registerRepo?, dryRun?}`
  - result `{importKey (sha256(source.runtimeId|workspace.instanceId)), disposition:'imported'|'replayed', repoId, worktreeId, instanceId, presentationSource:{kind:'client-view',clientKey}|{kind:'host-layout'}, idMap:{tabs,groups,leaves,browsers}, bindings:[{sourcePaneKey, localPaneKey, providerSessionId, status:'dormant'|'resumed'|'refused', reason?, terminalHandle?}], provenance}`
  - steps: local-only gate → zod + version → realpath checkout, resolve registered local repo by git common dir (repo.add only with registerRepo) → importKey; same importKey already applied → 'replayed' (layout untouched, merge only new dormant bindings, never replace a live pane); worktree has foreign tabs → `recovery_destination_not_empty`; regenerate all ids; remap paths; apply atomically through the authoritative writer (renderer IPC when a window is attached and awaited to persistence; else the runtime's own session writer); set defaultTerminalTabsAppliedByWorktreeId[worktreeId]=true; terminal ptyId null; one SleepingAgentSessionRecord per binding with origin 'recovery', restoreOnTabOpenOnly:false, launchConfig {agentArgs:'', agentEnv:{}}, recovery:{importKey, sourcePaneKey}; persist WorktreeMeta.recoveryProvenance; then resume selected ids. Never go through worktree.create, never run hooks/setup scripts/quick commands/default terminal tabs.
- `crossMachineRecovery.resume` {worktree, providerSessionId, presentation?:'focused'|'background'} → {terminalHandle, disposition:'created'|'adopted', localPaneKey}: atomically claim (remove) the 'recovery' sleeping record; refuse `recovery_session_live_locally` if that providerSession id is live on this host (restore the record); runtime.ensureAgentSession({kind:'explicit', worktree:`id:${worktreeId}`, agent, providerSession:{key,id,transcriptPath: remapped|undefined}, launchPreferences, presentation, placement:{tabId,leafId}}) — terminal.ensureAgentSession semantics, NEVER agentSession.ensure; host-default args only, never source agentArgs; on failure restore the record and rethrow. Surface that ensureAgentSession marks the checkout trusted for Claude.
- `crossMachineRecovery.list` {worktree?} → {bindings: dormant 'recovery' records + localPaneKey + worktreeId + provenance}
- `crossMachineRecovery.presentation.publish` (above)
- Error codes: recovery_local_only, recovery_unsupported, recovery_repo_unregistered, recovery_checkout_missing, recovery_destination_not_empty, recovery_descriptor_invalid, recovery_descriptor_too_large, recovery_session_live_locally, recovery_binding_not_found.
- Wake paths never auto-launch origin 'recovery' records: pane cold restore, worktree activation, mobile navigation (orca-runtime-apply-mobile-session-tab-navigation.ts), background wake (wake-sleeping-agents-in-background.ts), sleeping-agent-pane-ownership.ts, agent-status-sleeping-records.ts isDurableSleepingCapture. The pane shows a "Recovered session — Resume" affordance that calls crossMachineRecovery.resume. The closed-enum origin schema (workspace-session-sleeping-agents.ts) and its tests change together.

## Orca CLI verbs (always local; JSON envelope {ok:true,result} / {ok:false,error:{code,message}} + non-zero exit)
- `orca recovery describe --json`
- `orca recovery export --worktree <selector> --json`
- `orca recovery import --descriptor <path|-> --checkout <path> --checkpoint <id> [--path-map <from>=<to>]... [--resume <providerSessionId>]... [--prefer-client <clientInstanceId>] [--activate] [--register-repo] [--dry-run] --json` (descriptor read with a byte cap)
- `orca recovery resume --worktree <selector> --session <providerSessionId> [--focus] --json`
- `orca recovery list [--worktree <selector>] --json`

## cc-sync CLI JSON consumed by the native picker (cc-sync lane implements; Orca parses with a checked parser in src/shared/cross-machine-recovery-provider-types.ts, unknown enum values degrade to 'unknown', snake_case keys)
Every cc-sync --json output carries "version":1. Failure: {"version":1,"ok":false,"error":{"code","message"}} on stdout + non-zero exit (2 usage, 3 not-found, 4 refused, 5 unavailable).
- `cc-sync status --json` → {version, ok:true, helper:{running,build}, local:{host_id,host_name,network:{status,expensive,constrained,cellular,manual_metered}}, peers:[{host_id,host_name,reachable,last_seen_at,acked_revision,pending_revision,pending_since,pause:{reason,endpoint,since}|null}], scheduler:{queued_by_tier:{human,autonomous,recent,idle},workers,last_round_at}}
- `cc-sync list --json [--source <host>] [--repo <path|origin>] [--all]` → {version, ok:true, generated_at, local:{host_id,host_name}, items:[Item]}
  Item = {selector ("<source_host_id>/<workspace_id>", stable), source:{host_id,host_name,last_seen_at,reachable}, workspace:{id, repo_name, repo_origin, branch, source_path, orca:{kind:'worktree'|'folder', name, instance_id}|null}, sessions:[{session_id, title, last_activity_at, last_human_activity_at, activity:'human'|'autonomous'|'idle', bound_in_orca, live_local_collision}], checkpoint:{id, tier:'latest'|'hourly'|'daily', captured_at, source_activity_at}, checkpoint_count, completeness:{ready, missing:[string], transcript:'complete'|'partial'|'missing', code:'complete'|'deferred'|'missing'|'none', layout:'client-view'|'host-only'|'none'}, pause:{reason:'cellular'|'expensive'|'constrained'|'unknown-network'|'disconnected'|'manual-metered'|'peer-offline', endpoint:'local'|'peer', since}|null, local_checkout:{path, reusable}|null}
  Timestamps RFC3339 UTC.
- `cc-sync inspect <selector|session> [--checkpoint <sel>] --json` → Item plus checkpoints:[{id,tier,captured_at,ready,missing,deferred}] and delivery:[{peer, state, pause}]
- `cc-sync pickup <selector|session> [--checkpoint <sel>] [--resume <session_id>]... [--no-orca] [--dry-run] [--progress ndjson] --json` → {version, ok:true, checkout:{path,branch,reused}, sessions:[{session_id, status:'resumed'|'dormant'|'restored'}], orca:{execution_host_id:'local', worktree_id, resumed:[{session_id, tab_id}], dormant:[session_id]}|null}. Error codes: not-ready, live-local-collision, orca-not-local, orca-unavailable, checkout-conflict, cancelled, not-found, unsupported. With --progress ndjson, stderr carries one JSON line per phase {"phase":"select"|"restore-code"|"restore-sessions"|"orca-import"|"orca-resume","done"?,"total"?}. Cancel = SIGTERM to the process group; pickup must leave no half-applied destination (fresh recovery worktree is removed on cancel before Orca import).
- `cc-sync resume <session_id>` (interactive, not used by the picker): execs `claude --resume <sid>` in the restored cwd, refusing live-local collisions.
- Selectors: `<session>` full id, unique prefix, or `<source>:<sid>`; item selector `<source_host_id>/<workspace_id>`. `--checkpoint`: latest (default), `<id-prefix>`, `at:<RFC3339>`, `hourly:-<N>h`, `daily:<YYYY-MM-DD>`.
- Picker main bridge: runProcess/spawnProcess from src/shared/child-process (argv arrays, no shell); env = process.env minus ORCA_ENVIRONMENT/ORCA_PAIRING_CODE/ORCA_REMOTE_PAIRING plus CC_SYNC_ORCA_CLIENT_INSTANCE_ID=<clientInstanceId>; status/list/inspect time out after 15 s with bounded output; pickup cancellable and streams progress. cc-sync pickup passes `--prefer-client $CC_SYNC_ORCA_CLIENT_INSTANCE_ID` to `orca recovery import`.
- Picker behavior: rows show source, workspace, session title/id, age, completeness, pause reason; ready:false and live_local_collision rows disabled with reason; default resume selection = the session with the most recent human activity in the item, others import dormant; entry points: Cmd-J quick action `recover-sessions` (hidden on web or when unsupported) + status-bar segment; mounted in AppRootSurfaces.tsx; on success activateAndRevealWorktree(worktreeId, {executionHostId:'local'}).

## Decided defaults
dirtyDraftContent not exported; source agentArgs never reused; replayed import never re-adds closed tabs; picker execs the provider CLI (no socket RPC); repo auto-register only with --register-repo; target Orca main and gate by capability; no mobile app changes (host may derive low-fidelity presentation from mobileClientTabSelectionsByDeviceId); SSH workspaces export 'host-bindings-only'; input excludes composer/draft text.
ops.when: Implementing or reviewing Orca crossMachineRecovery RPC/CLI/picker or cc-sync orcabridge/CLI JSON consumed by Orca
